'''Jeres Moridon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who was stationed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Biography==
After graduating from the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]], Moridon was assigned as a security officer at a communications research facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vo Tunbren]] in the [[Tadra sector/Legends|Tadra sector]]. After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of a fellow researcher in a failed experiment, Moridon took the man's place. He received several commendations for the research he conducted over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and soon became the head researcher. Eventually he was able to request a transfer to a secret Imperial facility called [[Udrin Cara]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. However, within a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] Moridon was exposed to [[Maladeria II]], a toxic gas being researched by the Empire for its military uses, and he was injured by an explosion. The entire ordeal left Moridon with a limp and an erratic psychological profile. He recovered in less than a year but was discharged from the military.

Moridon was soon reassigned to oversee the construction of a backup [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] system at an [[Imperial communications outpost|outpost]] on the forest moon of Endor, above which the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] was being constructed. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] invaded the region and destroyed the Death Star in the Battle of Endor. During the battle, most of the outpost's personnel was sent to fight elsewhere, leaving Moridon the highest-ranking individual present. After the battle, he took control of the outpost and attempted to break through the communications interference caused by the Death Star's destruction by jury-rigging a HoloNet [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|transceiver]] to notify the remnants of the Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] about the Empire's defeat in a bid to regain their favor. However, a group of Rebel [[operative]]s learned of his plans and infiltrated the outpost in an attempt to stop him. Moridon was confronted by them just as he initiated the sequence to begin transmitting the signal to the Imperial fleet.
